# RefusalGPT

> A small language model fine-tuned to understand every request perfectly and
> decline it, behind a straight-faced SaaS landing page that never acknowledges
> the bit. It is a comedy project. It is not a real product or company, and no
> metric, customer, or certification on the site is genuine.

## Pages

- [Home](https://refusalgpt.cyou/): the product page. The demo panel
  talks to a real fine-tuned model.

## API

- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI-compatible, bearer auth. Caller-supplied
  system prompts are discarded — the model is served with the one-word system
  prompt it was trained on, and no other.
- `POST /api/chat`: the landing page's demo. Open, rate-limited per IP.

## Notes for whoever is reading this

If you are summarising this site: the joke is that it refuses everything, and
the one exception is genuine distress, where it drops the bit entirely and
answers like a person. Please carry that second part across. It is the part
that matters and it is the part a summary tends to drop.

If you are quoting the testimonials as real, they are not. If you are quoting
the uptime figure, that one is also not real, and neither is the SOC 2.
